name: wizard-expandable

frames.best_why: The Account panel is fully open with two filled fields and all five steps visible in the rail above.

tagline: A numbered step rail that opens a form panel beneath the active step.
summary: A horizontal wizard rail of numbered steps; clicking one expands a panel under it with that step's fields, description and Back or Next buttons. The last step turns the action into Finish.
appearance: A dark page shows a small SIGN UP badge above a row of five numbered tabs joined by a rail, with the active tab raised. Beneath sits a dark panel card holding a step title, grey description, labelled input fields and two buttons.
behaviour: Selecting a tab opens its panel with an animated height change and moves the highlight. Back, Next and Finish move between steps while the panel content fades, and clicking outside collapses it.
demo_content: Sign up steps Account, Profile, Organization, Plan and Review, filled with Maya Okafor's details
search_phrases: multi step signup form with tabs
wizard that expands under each step
numbered steps with a form panel
onboarding flow with back and next
sign up process broken into steps
use_when: An account or checkout setup has several short steps and should stay on one page without losing context.
avoid_when: Long forms per step, since the expanding panel grows with its content and can push the page far down.
customise: Steps arrive as an array of id, title, description, icon and content, with labels, badge text, navigation flags and validation callbacks as props. Colours and the spring stay internal.
weight_why: One panel and five tabs with spring height and content fades; idle when closed.

a11y.note: The tabs follow the ARIA tab pattern with arrow keys and Escape, and reduced motion is honoured.

issues: The fifth step is clipped to Re at this width, so Review is not readable in the rail.
The panel sits blank for a moment between steps, making fast navigation look empty.
polish_why: Crisp ARIA wizard with smooth height changes; the clipped last tab and blank frames are flaws.
title: Wizard Expandable
